slug: 2026-01-27 Egypt launches DHIS2 in its national health information system

systems.country_label: DHIS2, as part of the national health information system
systems.owner: Ministry of Health and Population, with UNICEF Egypt, the HISP Centre (University of Oslo), HISP MENA and the Royal Norwegian Embassy
systems.tiers: First-year use at 189 sites for Gaza evacuees and 57 TB centres; tiers not stated

note: No fact: the document describes DHIS2 only by programme-specific, patient-level uses (180,000+ consultations for Gaza evacuees at 189 sites, nutrition screening of about 20,000 Sudanese refugee children, school-health screening of 100,000+ children, TB follow-up of 7,500 cases at 57 centres), not by routine aggregate facility reporting, so it is classed tracker by what it does. For the parent: it states the MoHP officially launched DHIS2 at a meeting on 18 January 2026, framed as national ownership of health data and supporting the National Digital Health Strategic Priorities 2025-2029; if the parent reads this as hmis, those are governance (owner:ministry, plan:current) and last12 (advancing) statements.
